correction.text: the city-state in western Morelos: 'founded in about 650 AD by the Olmeca-Xicallanca'; 'The city-state had a population of 10,000 to 15,000 people'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row). The page gives no territory ('an excellent position along several of the major Mesoamerican trade routes'); a 30 km radius around the hill in western Morelos is the researcher's reading of a city-state of 10,000–20,000. The UNESCO zone is 707.65 ha.

ledger.note: 650: Xochicalco is founded by the Olmeca-Xicallanca. 'Xochicalco was founded in about 650 AD by the Olmeca-Xicallanca'; 'The site was first occupied by 200 BC' but 'did not develop into an urban center until the Epiclassic period (AD 700 – 900)'; 'The apogee of Xochicalco came after the fall of Teotihuacan'. (Review am-01, 2026-10-18: confidence 2, not 3: the page dates the event but names no territory; the 30 km radius is the researcher's reading)

900: Xochicalco is burned and destroyed. 'At some point around 900 CE the city of Xochicalco was burned and destroyed'; 'A small remnant population lived on, however, on the lower slopes of the hill'; the Teotihuacan page: 'Xochicalco was sacked and burned in 900'. 'Later, around 1200, the site was recolonized by the Nahuatl-speaking Tlahuica peoples'. (Review am-01, 2026-10-18: confidence 2, not 3: the page dates the event but names no territory; the 30 km radius is the researcher's reading)
